notes.title: PLAY CRUSH LINK TD FOR FREE
notes.content:
Hi everyone 👋🏼

We are pleased to announce that one year after its release, Crush Link TD will be available on Steam for free starting February 1st, 2025.

Play, share your experience and comments. 

Cheers! ✌🏼️😉

notes.title: WE LOVE READING YOUR FEEDBACK
notes.content:
Hi everyone 👋🏼

Honest user reviews are the key stone for navigating on Steam for players.
Please help others to learn more about Crush Link TD and share your game experience writing a review.

We would highly appreciate it. Thank you!

Cheers! ✌🏼️😉

notes.title: GAME RELEASE
notes.content:
Hi everyone 👋🏼

We are happy to present you the very first game of our indie team.
Crush Link TD is officially available on Steam.

Play, share your experience and comments. 

Cheers! ✌🏼️😉
